content: Our visual model is based on fine-tuning an Inception V3 model BIBREF1 over visual renderings of documents, while our textual model is based on a hierarchical biLSTM. We further combine the two into a joint model. We perform experiments on two datasets: a Wikipedia dataset novel to this paper, and an arXiv dataset provided by BIBREF2 split into three sub-parts based on subject category. Experimental results on the visual renderings of documents show that implicit quality indicators, such as images and visual layout, can be captured by an image classifier, at a level comparable to a text classifier. When we combine the two models, we achieve state-of-the-art results over 3/4 of our datasets.
